title: Decision-Aware Suffix Prediction and Reasoning of Business Processes
abstract: arXiv:2609.06169v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Suffix prediction forecasts the remaining sequence of events of a running case until completion. Most approaches rely on neural networks trained on event logs, which, on average, perform well but struggle with short prefixes or targets belonging to a rare process variant. In such scenarios, the correct path may cross multiple branching decisions, determined primarily by case- and event-level attributes, a signal that NN-based suffix prediction models tend to underweight because they may heavily weight (dense) event labels. Decision mining extracts rules for such decisions from the event log, but has so far been applied only to post-hoc and what-if analysis, not suffix prediction. We therefore extend suffix prediction with decision mining, introducing a decision-aware suffix prediction framework, a neuro-symbolic approach that enables reasoning about predicted events via mined decision rules. translated_title: 业务流程的决策感知后缀预测与推理
translated_abstract: 后缀预测旨在预测一个运行中案例直至完成所剩余的事件序列。大多数方法依赖于在事件日志上训练的神经网络，这些方法在平均意义上表现良好，但在处理短前缀或属于罕见流程变体的目标时表现不佳。在这些场景中，正确的路径可能跨越多个分支决策，而这些决策主要由案例级和事件级属性决定——基于神经网络的后缀预测模型往往低估这一信号，因为它们可能严重偏向（密集的）事件标签。决策挖掘可以从事件日志中提取此类决策的规则，但迄今为止仅被应用于事后分析和假设分析，而非后缀预测。因此，我们将决策挖掘与后缀预测相结合，提出了一种决策感知的后缀预测框架，这是一种神经符号方法，能够通过挖掘到的决策规则对预测事件进行推理。在四个事件日志中的三个上进行的实验……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种决策感知的后缀预测框架，将决策挖掘与神经网络后缀预测相结合，通过神经符号方法利用挖掘出的决策规则对预测事件进行推理，从而改善短前缀和罕见流程变体场景下的预测效果。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a decision-aware suffix prediction framework that extends neural suffix prediction with decision mining, enabling neuro-symbolic reasoning about predicted events via mined decision rules to improve predictions for short prefixes and rare process variants.
